headline: Where to find Jetragon in Palworld 1.0
title: Where to Find Jetragon in Palworld | New Sunreach Location | Palworld Guide
video_script: Jetragon moved in Palworld one point zero! It's no longer near Mount Obsidian. Jetragon is now a level seventy Alpha on the Sunreach sky islands, at Dragonmark Peak, around minus five five three, minus one three three two. You need to unlock Sunreach first, and the only way there is to fly, so bring a flying mount. Jetragon is weak to Ice, so pack Ice Pals and your best spheres. Is Jetragon still the best mount? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Jetragon location: a level 70 Alpha on the Sunreach sky islands at Dragonmark Peak, around (-553, -1332). It moved from Mount Obsidian and was raised from level 50. Weak to Ice.
